summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Admin/Teacher auth & user-management model plus regression of the untouched assessment engine. Backend: 81/81 pytest tests pass (17 new auth/admin tests in tests/test_admin_auth_v4.py + 64 pre-existing engine/regression tests after updating conftest to username login). Frontend: admin login -> Manage Teachers (nav shows only 'Manage Teachers'), create teacher (auto-password + regen), created-panel with username/temp password, Send Login Credentials placeholder toast, teacher appears in list, edit updates subjects, disable flips status and blocks login with 'This account has been disabled' toast, re-enable restores login, new teacher logs in by USERNAME and sees 'Your Teaching Portfolio' with correct subjects/classes and quick-access cards, seeded priya.math portfolio (Mathematics, Class 11/12) OK, role separation redirects both ways OK, all engine pages (/generate, /exams, /studio, /proctoring, /attempts, /analytics) load error-free and /exam student join page works without login.

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint — admin can only disable, never remove a teacher. Test/obsolete accounts accumulate forever (I removed 12 leftover TEST_ users directly from Mongo).

No validation on username format (accepts spaces/uppercase before lower-casing) and no password strength/complexity check beyond min_length=4; TeacherCreateInput.email is a plain str (not EmailStr) so an invalid email can be stored.
Duplicate email/username relies on a find_one pre-check; a concurrent insert would raise a raw DuplicateKeyError -> 500 instead of 400 (unique indexes exist but the error is not caught).

Seed is non-updating for the existing teacher: the DB doc name is 'Dr. Sarah Chen' while seed.py declares 'Priya Sharma', and the seed-path password for a NEW install is 'Teacher@2026' while the documented/actual one is 'Edora@2026'. A fresh environment would therefore NOT match the documented credentials priya.math/Edora@2026.

issues: Plaintext credentials are printed on the page ('Admin: admin / Admin@2026 · Teacher: priya.math / Edora@2026'). Fine for a demo, must be removed before any real use.
'YOUR FULL NAME' is pre-filled with the logged-in teacher's name (e.g. 'Dr. Sarah Chen') when a teacher session exists — a student on a shared device could submit under the teacher's name.
No confirmation dialog for disable/enable (single click instantly disables an account); no delete option in the UI (backend has none either).

action_items: seed.py: make the seeded teacher self-heal (name + password) so a fresh DB really gives priya.math / Edora@2026; the current doc name 'Dr. Sarah Chen' contradicts the code and the login-page hint.
Remove the hardcoded credential hint from Login.js before production.
Add DELETE /api/admin/teachers/{id} (or soft-delete) so admins can remove staff; disabled-only leaves the list unbounded.
Harden teacher create/update validation: EmailStr for email, username regex, stronger min password length, and catch DuplicateKeyError -> 400.
Do not pre-fill the student name on /exam from the teacher session.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 817 lines — split routers (auth/admin, exams, attempts, analytics) into modules.
login() lockout counter is keyed on the raw identifier, so an attacker can lock out any known username/email (account-keyed DoS). Consider combining identifier+IP or exponential backoff.
Anonymous access to /api/admin/* correctly returns 401 and teacher access 403; no MongoDB _id or password_hash leaks in any admin/auth response (verified).
updated_files: /app/memory/test_credentials.md (was stale: documented email login + wrong endpoints)
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway teachers test_qa.* via admin API/UI; all TEST_/test_qa users (12) deleted from Mongo afterwards. Seeded admin/priya.math/teacher.math.class12 left untouched and unlocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login body is {username,password}; conftest.py now exposes admin_client/teacher_client/student_client with Bearer tokens. IMPORTANT: requests.Session keeps httpOnly cookies, so reusing an authenticated session for anonymous 401 checks yields 403 — use a fresh Session. There is no DELETE for teachers; clean test teachers directly from Mongo (users collection). 5 wrong logins on one identifier => 423/15min, use throwaway usernames.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found this iteration. The two initial test failures were test-hygiene issues (shared session cookies, and old tests still posting {email,...} to the new {username,...} login schema) and were fixed in the test code only.
